tour1.title: In the Heart of Tien Shan: Mountains, Lakes, and Adventures
tour1.description: This tour is designed for lovers of nature, active recreation, and real mountain adventures. Majestic Tien Shan peaks, picturesque gorges, crystal-clear alpine lakes, hot springs, and the unique atmosphere of Kyrgyz nature await you.
tour1.fullDescription: The route combines light hikes along mountain trails, relaxation amidst alpine landscapes, immersive local culture experiences, and opportunities to capture unforgettable photos.

day1.title: Arrival in Bishkek
day1.text: Airport meetup, hotel transfer, team introduction, and a city walking tour.

day2.title: Ala-Archa Gorge
day2.text: Hike to the waterfall or alpine camp surrounded by majestic coniferous forests and mountain peaks.

day3.title: Transfer to Lake Issyk-Kul
day3.text: Scenic drive through Boom Gorge, visit to Burana Tower, and evening by the lake.

day4.title: Grigorievskoye and Semenovskoye Gorges
day4.text: Off-road driving and light trekking to high-altitude lakes, horse riding available.

day5.title: Karakol and Altyn-Arashan Hot Springs
day5.text: Karakol city sightseeing and ascent to natural thermal hot springs.

day6.title: Skazka (Fairy Tale) Canyon & Barskoon Gorge
day6.text: Photoshoot among red sandstone formations and towering waterfalls.

day7.title: Return to Bishkek via Bokonbaevo
day7.text: Eagle hunting demonstration with traditional eagle hunters and overnight in a yurt camp.

tour2.title: Bishkek – Issyk-Kul
tour2.description: A 6-day journey through the main highlights of Kyrgyzstan: Bishkek, Burana Tower, Lake Issyk-Kul, Karakol, Jeti-Oguz Gorge, and Ala-Archa National Park.
tour2.fullDescription:
This tour is perfect for travelers who want to experience the culture, history, and nature of Kyrgyzstan.

You will visit the capital Bishkek, the ancient 11th-century Burana Tower from the Silk Road era, the famous Lake Issyk-Kul, Karakol city, historical landmarks, and one of the country's most beautiful gorges — Jeti-Oguz.

The itinerary blends lakeside relaxation, cultural discovery of Kyrgyzstan's diverse peoples, Tian Shan mountain scenery, and nature walks.

day1.title: Bishkek — Discovering the Capital
day1.text: Airport meeting and hotel check-in. Bishkek city tour: Ala-Too Square, National Historical Museum, Oak Park, Victory Square, and Osh Bazaar. Traditional national dinner in the evening.

day2.title: Burana Tower — Issyk-Kul
day2.text: After breakfast, visit Burana Tower, an 11th-century Silk Road monument. Following the excursion, transfer to Lake Issyk-Kul and hotel check-in.

day3.title: Issyk-Kul — Cholpon-Ata
day3.text: Relax on the shores of Lake Issyk-Kul. Visit the open-air Petroglyph Museum, Ruh Ordo Cultural Center, and enjoy a waterfront walk. Boat ride and summer swimming options available.

day4.title: Karakol — Jeti-Oguz
day4.text: Karakol city tour: Holy Trinity Orthodox Cathedral, Dungan Mosque, and Historical Museum. Drive to Jeti-Oguz Gorge: famous Seven Bulls rocks, Red Rocks, nature walks, and photoshoots in the Tian Shan mountains.

day5.title: Return to Bishkek
day5.text: Return drive to Bishkek through scenic spots of the Issyk-Kul region. Free time and a farewell dinner at a national restaurant.

day6.title: Ala-Archa National Park — Departure
day6.text: After breakfast, trip to Ala-Archa National Park. Walk among coniferous forests, mountain rivers, and alpine meadows. Light trekking option available. Airport transfer following the excursion.

tour3.title: Two Capitals of Kyrgyzstan: Bishkek – Ala-Archa – Osh
tour3.description: A 5-day journey through the two main cultural hubs of Kyrgyzstan: modern Bishkek, Ala-Archa National Park, ancient Osh, Sulaiman-Too, and Silk Road heritage.
tour3.fullDescription:
Discover the two most vibrant regions of Kyrgyzstan — modern Bishkek and ancient Osh.

This tour seamlessly combines nature, history, culture, and rich local traditions.

You will marvel at the majestic Tian Shan mountains, visit Ala-Archa National Park, and immerse yourself in the authentic atmosphere of Osh, one of Central Asia's oldest cities.

The itinerary highlights natural wonders, historical monuments, local cuisine, and genuine Kyrgyz hospitality.

day1.title: Arrival in Bishkek — Ala-Archa
day1.text: Meetup at Manas International Airport and hotel transfer. Bishkek city tour: Ala-Too Square, State Historical Museum, Oak Park, Victory Square, Kyrgyz National Philharmonic, and Osh Bazaar. Followed by a drive to Ala-Archa National Park for mountain trail walks, panoramic views of Tian Shan peaks, rivers, and pine forests.

day2.title: Flight Bishkek — Osh
day2.text: After breakfast, airport transfer for a domestic flight to Osh. Hotel check-in upon arrival followed by a city tour: sacred Sulaiman-Too Mountain, cave museum, observation deck, central square, and Ak-Buura riverfront.

day3.title: History and Traditions of Osh Region
day3.text: Day trip to the ancient town of Uzgen. Visit the 11th-century Uzgen Minaret, Karakhanid Mausoleums, and local historical museum. Discover Silk Road heritage, taste famous Uzgen plov, and visit a craft center and local farm.

day4.title: Nature and Culture of Southern Kyrgyzstan
day4.text: Visit scenic mountain areas of Osh region. Valley walks, immersive experience in a traditional Kyrgyz village, nomadic culture, and local food. Optional horseback riding, folk music performance, and traditional costume photoshoot.

day5.title: Osh — Departure
day5.text: Free time after breakfast for souvenir shopping and visiting the oriental bazaar. Transfer to Osh International Airport.

tour4.title: In the Footsteps of the Silk Road: Bishkek – Suusamyr – Talas
tour4.description: A journey to the Talas Valley — a hub of the Great Silk Road, epic legends of Manas, and unique Tian Shan nature. Experience jailoo pastures, nomadic culture, history, and stunning mountain landscapes.
tour4.fullDescription:
Discover a hidden gem of Kyrgyzstan — the scenic Talas Valley.

This route intertwines the rich history of the Silk Road, heroic legends of the Epic of Manas, and breathtaking Tian Shan landscapes.

You will witness authentic Kyrgyz jailoo pastures, experience nomadic heritage, explore ancient historic sites, and enjoy the pristine beauty of Kyrgyzstan's high mountain regions.

day1.title: Bishkek — Suusamyr Valley — Talas
day1.text: Morning departure from Bishkek. Drive through the Suusamyr Valley, one of Kyrgyzstan's most scenic high-altitude plateaus. See lush green jailoo pastures, herds of horses and sheep, roaring mountain rivers, and snow-capped peaks. Stop at the Too-Ashuu Pass for panoramic mountain ridge views. Traditional lunch en route before continuing to Talas Valley. Hotel check-in and evening city walk.

day2.title: Talas — History of the Great Silk Road
day2.text: Excursion starts at the Manas Ordo memorial complex. Visit the Epic of Manas museum and learn about Manaschi storytellers and Kyrgyz traditions. Continue to the site of the famous Battle of Talas (751 AD), a pivotal Silk Road event. Learn about the role of the Talas Valley in Central Asian history and explore the ancient city area of Atlakh.

day3.title: Talas Nature — Besh-Tash National Park
day3.text: After breakfast, trip to Besh-Tash National Park. Enjoy a hike through the mountain gorge, visit Lake Besh-Tash, relax amidst alpine meadows, and marvel at the Talas Ala-Too range. Optional activities: horseback riding, meeting local shepherds, tasting fresh kymyz (fermented mare's milk) and local products.

day4.title: Talas — Bishkek
day4.text: After breakfast, return journey to Bishkek. Photo stops along the way, visits to local markets with opportunities to buy natural Talas honey, kurut, and traditional handcrafted souvenirs. Evening arrival in Bishkek.

tour5.title: Classic Tour of Kyrgyzstan: Bishkek – Issyk-Kul – Son-Kul
tour5.description: A 10-day expedition through three regions of Kyrgyzstan: Chuy, Issyk-Kul, and Naryn. Experience the Tian Shan nature, Lakes Issyk-Kul and Son-Kul, nomadic lifestyle, and traditional yurts.
tour5.fullDescription:
This classic itinerary covers three major regions of Kyrgyzstan: Chuy, Issyk-Kul, and Naryn.

Throughout the journey, you will discover the rich cultural heritage of the Kyrgyz people, authentic nomadic life, and untouched Tian Shan nature.

The route encompasses Bishkek, Ala-Archa National Park, the historical Burana Tower, Lake Issyk-Kul, Karakol gorges, high-altitude Lake Son-Kul, and an overnight stay in a traditional yurt camp.

This is the ultimate grand tour for first-time visitors to Kyrgyzstan.

day1.title: Manas Airport — Bishkek — Ala-Archa
day1.text: Meetup at Manas International Airport. Transfer to Bishkek, breakfast, and hotel check-in. After rest, drive to Ala-Archa National Park for a gorge hike, mountain river scenery, and Tian Shan nature views. Return to Bishkek.

day2.title: Bishkek — Burana Tower — Cholpon-Ata
day2.text: Drive to Lake Issyk-Kul via mountain routes. Visit the 10th–11th century Burana Tower historical complex, remnant of ancient Balasagun. Travel through Boom Gorge to Cholpon-Ata open-air petroglyph museum. Lakeside hotel check-in.

day3.title: Cholpon-Ata — Grigorievskoye Gorge — Karakol
day3.text: Excursion to Grigorievskoye Gorge on the northern shore of Issyk-Kul. See alpine lakes, pastures, pristine nature, and traditional nomad camps. Optional hike to upper lakes followed by transfer to Karakol.

day4.title: Karakol — Altyn-Arashan
day4.text: Trip to Altyn-Arashan gorge, famous for natural hot mineral springs and alpine views. 4x4 mountain drive, relaxation, and thermal hot spring bathing. Return to Karakol for the night.

day5.title: Karakol — Jeti-Oguz — Tamga
day5.text: Visit Jeti-Oguz Gorge to see Seven Bulls red rock formations and Broken Heart rock. Enjoy mountain walks before driving along the southern shore of Issyk-Kul to Tamga village.

day6.title: Barskoon — Arabel Pass — Skazka Canyon
day6.text: Barskoon Gorge tour featuring waterfalls and the Yuri Gagarin monument. Ascend Arabel Pass (~3800m high plateau). On the way back, explore Skazka (Fairy Tale) Canyon's multi-colored red rock formations.

day7.title: Tamga — Kochkor — Lake Son-Kul
day7.text: Travel to high-altitude Lake Son-Kul via Kochkor village. Visit a traditional felt craft workshop, learn about Kyrgyz handicrafts, and enjoy lunch with a local family. Continue to Son-Kul and check into a traditional yurt camp.

day8.title: Lake Son-Kul — Nomadic Life
day8.text: Leisure day on the shores of Lake Son-Kul. Experience Kyrgyz nomadic traditions, visit local yurts, see high pastures, and learn about local customs. Optional horseback riding or light mountain trekking.

day9.title: Son-Kul — Bishkek
day9.text: Drive back to Bishkek over Teskei-Torpok and Dolon passes. En route, view Orto-Tokoy reservoir and travel back through Boom Gorge. Farewell dinner in Bishkek in the evening.

day10.title: Bishkek — Manas Airport
day10.text: After breakfast, transfer to Manas International Airport for your departure flight. End of tour.
